en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Yaqteen, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Abu Al Jaroud, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘But rather Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Hold the servants (responsible) regarding the Reckoning on the Day of Judgment upon a measurement of what He<sup>azwj</sup> had Given them from the intellects in the world’.
